internal.title: Incident Resolved: High Kafka Consumer Lag in Accounting Service
internal.body:
At 12:07 UTC, an alert for high Kafka consumer lag was triggered in the accounting service, indicating a backlog of 5200 records. The diagnosis confirmed a queue backlog as the root cause. The mitigation involved disabling a Kafka-related flag, which was approved and executed by 12:27 UTC. Recovery was verified with the consumer lag returning to normal levels. No further errors or backlogs were detected post-mitigation.

Key timeline:
- 12:07 Alert received for KafkaConsumerLagHigh
- 12:27 Diagnosis confirmed queue backlog
- 12:27 Flag disabling proposed, approved, and executed
- 12:27 Recovery verified with normalized consumer lag

The checkout and frontend services showed elevated error ratios but were not the primary cause of this incident.

external.body: Between 12:07 and 12:27 UTC, the accounting service experienced delays in processing messages, causing a temporary backlog. This issue has been resolved, and normal service operation has resumed. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your understanding.
